production.selection: Use the production server for this corpus scenario.

protocolsAndBindings.headerEncoding: Kafka record headers encode each logical header as one UTF-8 value.
protocolsAndBindings.clientExposure: Expose logical headers by their documented names.

authentication.credentialAcquisition: Obtain a client-credentials token from the configured synthetic authorization service.
authentication.credentialRotation: Acquire a replacement token before the current token expires.

connectionAndSession.reconnect: Reconnect with bounded exponential backoff from 100 milliseconds to 10 seconds.
connectionAndSession.sessionFailure: Stop publishing while no authenticated broker session is available.

serialization.schemaResolution: Schemas are fully projected inline; the client does not perform runtime schema lookup.

delivery.redeliveryVisibility: A redelivery retains the original message-id.

acknowledgement.nack: Negative-acknowledge a delivery after a retryable handler failure.
acknowledgement.positive: Acknowledge only after durable processing commits.
acknowledgement.timeout: Unacknowledged deliveries become eligible for redelivery after 30 seconds.

ordering.guarantee: Messages sharing payload.orderId are processed in publish order.
ordering.negativeGuarantee: There is no ordering guarantee across distinct orderId values.

failureRecovery.retryAction: Negative-acknowledge retryable failures; reject non-retryable failures.
failureRecovery.terminalAction: Publish the failed envelope and diagnostic code to the dead-letter channel.

requestReply.correlation: The reply correlation-id equals the command correlation-id.
requestReply.timeoutMeaning: No acceptance reply arrived before the deadline; command outcome is unknown to the caller.

schemaEvolution.compatibility: Additive optional fields are backward compatible; removing or changing a required field requires a new contract version.

date-time.meaning: An RFC 3339 date-time string with an explicit offset.

emptyAndOmittedValues.nullability: All documented payload and header values are non-null.
emptyAndOmittedValues.omission: Only fields not listed as required may be omitted.

receiveOrderCreated.delivery: at-least-once -- Acknowledge after durable processing; negative-acknowledge retryable failures.
receiveOrderCreated.idempotency: Deduplicate redeliveries by header.message-id and preserve the prior durable result.
receiveOrderCreated.ordering: Preserve publish order for messages with the same payload.orderId.
receiveOrderCreated.preconditions: The storefront is subscribed to orders.events.
receiveOrderCreated.sideEffects: Update the storefront order state to created.
receiveOrderCreated.purpose: Update storefront order state from the created event.

sendCreateOrder.delivery: at-least-once -- Broker acknowledgement makes publish durable; timeout leaves outcome ambiguous.
sendCreateOrder.idempotency: Resend with the same header.message-id; consumers deduplicate for 24 hours.
sendCreateOrder.ordering: Publish commands sharing payload.orderId in order.
sendCreateOrder.preconditions: The referenced tenant and every SKU already exist.
sendCreateOrder.sideEffects: Ask the order service to create the submitted order.
sendCreateOrder.purpose: Submit one order command and await its acceptance reply.
sendCreateOrder.reply: The orderAccepted reply confirms command acceptance, not final fulfillment.

receiveOrderCreated.condition: Durable processing did not commit and another attempt may succeed.
receiveOrderCreated.action: Negative-acknowledge and re-process; after five attempts publish the failed envelope and diagnostic code to orders.dead-letter.

receiveOrderCreated.condition: The message cannot succeed without a contract or configuration change.
receiveOrderCreated.action: Reject without re-processing and publish the failed envelope and diagnostic code to orders.dead-letter.

sendCreateOrder.condition: Authorization or channel configuration rejects the publish.
sendCreateOrder.action: Do not retry with the same configuration; correct authorization or channel configuration before resending.

sendCreateOrder.condition: The command publish may have succeeded but no acceptance reply arrived.
sendCreateOrder.action: Resend with the same message-id when retrying so consumers deduplicate; escalate after five attempts.
